name: The Cinderella Contract
storyline:
As a multilingual staff, you accompanied your business partner to a party with many foreign celebrities, where you happened to meet handsome and wealthy Princes!

Your prince escorted you a bit aggressively, and you spent a dreamlike night which was too good to be true.

And the next morning...

You attempted to go back to Japan, but unfortunately couldn't pass the inspection! The guy who helped you out was the Prince from last night...!? He urges you to sign a marriage contract as a payback!

His orders are undeniable!

Does true love awaits beyond the false royal marriage?

Or else...
summary: A multilingual professional spends a dreamlike night with a wealthy prince after meeting him at an elite party. When she gets unexpectedly stopped at airport customs the next morning, the prince steps in to rescue her... but insists she sign a fake marriage contract to pay him back. Caught up in his bold demands, she soon has to find out if a fake royal marriage can actually turn into real love.
